profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I'm an android application developer with a passion for design. I love designing and developing applications that people will love interacting with and that provide an innate level of intuitiveness. I'm looking forward to working on innovative software that will have a positive impact on the world around us.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: Collaborated with design and API teams to build a variety of custom user interfaces using latest Android programming techniques. And created automated tests across multiple areas of the app to ensure the delivery of a quality product.

positions.title: Project Assistant
positions.description: Conducted user research through interviews and surveys to better assess the needs of end users in order to maximize the intuitiveness of our end product. This led to the creation of a new mobile application that helps diabetes patients with weight management.

positions.title: User Experience Intern
positions.description: Designed new features for the STEM-Away platform including a personal message system and a bookmarking system based on feedback from our users.

positions.title: Web Application Development
positions.description: Collaborated with the team to create captivating web applications for nonprofit organizations to ensure their websites were up to date with modern industry standards.
